title: About me
bio:
I am Abdullah Khan, a freelance web developer, digital marketer and graphic designer based in Karachi. I do the whole job myself: the website, the ads that send people to it, and the visuals that make both look like one business.

I started IT courses at a young age and have kept studying since. Before freelancing I worked in sales, in quality assurance and in Node.js development.
rolesValue: Web developer (front end and full stack), digital marketer, graphic designer and brand strategist.
workedValue: Sales, quality assurance and Node.js development.
buildValue: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Node and Express, MongoDB, Supabase, Firebase, Git, REST APIs.
adsValue: Meta Ads, TikTok Promote, Instagram and Facebook marketing, lead generation and reporting.
createValue: Graphic design, UI and UX, short video in CapCut and AI-assisted creative production.
studiedValue: Modern Web Application Development at Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT).
handleValue: AbdullahKhan_369. The 369 is a nod to Nikola Tesla.
